Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Here is a proposal for you to review:

- **Venue:** the Loft. It holds up to 24 people, so it fits your 22. It is also wheelchair accessible, and Wi-Fi is included.
- **Coffee break:** one for each of your 22 attendees.
- **Projector:** one projector for the booking.



| Item | Detail | Price |
|---|---|---:|
| Loft (V2) | 4 hours | €420 |
| Coffee break (S1) | 22 people x €8 | €176 |
| Projector (S3) | one projector for the booking | €35 |
| **Total** | | **€631** |
| Budget | | €700 |
| Difference | | €69 under budget |



The package comes within your budget.

Please note these points:
- You asked for 3 hours. BrightRoom only offers 4-hour bookings, so the price for the 4-hour block applies. There is no shorter option.
- The Studio doesn't work for your group, because it holds a maximum of 12 people.
- We haven't checked availability for any date. This has to be done separately, and nothing is held for you at the moment.
- The listed prices are fixed.

If this suits you, please tell me your preferred date and I will check availability.

Kind regards
